notes.title: Update 1.3.2
notes.content:
[h1] New[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b] Running Challenge mode (BETA)[/b]
Now you can control your speed by tapping triggers fast, but remember also to slow down speed. You have 90 seconds to go as far as possible!

    [*][b]ComfortGrid[/b]
That prevents motionsickness. That can put On/Off on settings. This is on testing, That will maybe to change or leave on future updates.

    [*][b]Settings -button on Mainmenu[/b]
Now you can disable game music or put ComfortGrid On/Off.
[/list]

[b] New Ideas are welcome for Running challenge mode[/b]
This new mode will have false start, launch from ground, more obstacles (Waterhurdles), new enviroment obstacles and two different attemps (day and night) and these different scores will add together.
Also armswinnger movement style would be fun, I will try to make it.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hi all players!
This update have some new modes and new alarm system.

Changelog:

- Old game mode is now HardMode.

- New Normal mode, that is bit easier and comfortable play than hardmode. Normal mode have also Online Leaderboard.

- New training mode (Alpha), there you can practise your movement skills, and change the game speed slower or faster.
  
- Alarm system tells to you if you are too far away or too front of on your middle playarea. 

- Metal doors have a bug that they don't open every time when you press the button. They have now new shape temporarily.
